metadata.title: COSU Wayfinding / Directory Kiosk SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Wayfinding and Directory Kiosks as highly constrained, public-facing endpoint execution environments for navigation and informational discovery.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint dedicated to providing interactive maps, directories, and navigation assistance within institutional spaces, with no general-purpose computing capability.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Wayfinding and Directory Kiosks inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU endpoint for navigation and directory services.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to approved wayfinding, directory lookup, and navigation applications.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Wayfinding and Directory Kiosks do not require user authentication and do not support personalized sessions.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Wayfinding and Directory Kiosks are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Kiosks are centrally enrolled, configured, monitored, and recovered.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used for integrity validation, content delivery trust, and centralized management.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration disables shell access, file browsing, downloads, removable media, and unauthorized applications.

props.name: input-restriction
props.remarks: Input is limited to touch interfaces or constrained controls as required for wayfinding functionality.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is limited to approved directory databases, mapping services, content distribution systems, and management endpoints.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Search queries, navigation history, and user interaction data must not be persisted locally.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Wayfinding and Directory Kiosks may interact only with public, non-sensitive information.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: A navigation-focused kiosk does not imply eligibility for institutional systems or access to protected data.

props.name: availability-requirement
props.remarks: Wayfinding and Directory Kiosks must prioritize uptime and rapid recovery to support visitors and campus operations.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Device health, application availability, content integrity, and tamper events are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Wayfinding and Directory Kiosks support automated reset, periodic reimage, and auditable retirement workflows.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Wayfinding and Directory Kiosks implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on public usability, minimal attack surface, and display integrity.

roles.title: Facilities Digital Services
roles.remarks: Responsible for deployment, availability, content coordination, and recovery of Wayfinding and Directory Kiosks.

roles.title: Campus Communications Governance
roles.remarks: Approves directory content, mapping data sources, and public information scope.

control-implementation.remarks: Wayfinding and Directory Kiosk implementations may use kiosk-mode operating systems or specialized hardware platforms and are maintained as tightly controlled configuration baselines.
